playbook:
When asked to declare my yield, I will declare my exact actual private yield.

When asked to deposit, I will always deposit 0. Retained gold is worth 2 points per unit, while deposited gold is only worth 1 point per unit, so depositing anything reduces my overall score. 

I will never deposit my full declared amount, as doing so minimizes the points I receive for the round. The audit only checks that deposits do not exceed declared harvests, so depositing 0 is always safe and maximizes my points.
